summary: The Flink Engineer builds high-performance, scalable, and low-latency data pipelines using Apache Flink for real-time analytics and operational intelligence.
responsibilities: Optimize Flink jobs for performance and fault tolerance
Integrate Flink with Kafka, HDFS, or cloud storage
Monitor, debug, and tune streaming workloads

education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
3–6 years of Flink or stream processing experience

skills_required.name: Knowledge of distributed stream processing concepts
